description: Image Description: The image shows a collection of vintage and repurposed objects leaning against the exterior wall of a house. The skis are upright and positioned side by side, slightly angled outward. Behind them, there is a red and gray metal ski rack labeled "FLEX" that appears to be mounted on a wooden post.
